content:
Key
Value
activation_msg
The text of the activation message.
activation_barcode
URL of a QR code. Scan the code with Duo Mobile to
complete activation. This QR code contains the same
activation code as activation_url .
POST  /admin/v1/phones/[phone_id]/send_sms_activation
installation_msg
The text of the installation message. Only present if the
install  parameter was set to 1  in the request.
valid_secs
An integer indicating the number of seconds that the
activation URL remains valid.
